content.comment_body: Hello all, Can someone assist? I have successfully installed [product_name] on macOS 10.6.8 – it works well. Now I need help connecting it to my [product_name] [article_no]. I installed the Silicon Labs software and only see a message (screenshot attached). What might I be missing? I also installed cardinal-osx-[version_no]-release.dmg and the Silicon Labs CP210x USB to UART Bridge driver, but still can't see the USB port. Thank you. [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user was able to install [product_name] software on MacOS 10.6.8, but is unable to connect to the [product_name] device over USB. Despite installing recommended drivers (Silicon Labs and Cardinal-OSX), the USB port does not appear in the software, suggesting potential compatibility problems with hardware interfaces and driver support on MacOS.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that, after driver installation, the [product_name] device should be automatically detected and connected via USB on MacOS.
